releaseNotes: Allows Auto Buy to purchase the round Drone with its live Gems price, capped at the requested 40 diamonds. Uses the current replicated in-match gem balance before account-cache fallback, waits for sufficient funds, and retains owned/pending purchase guards. Robux-only items and automatic gem purchases for other tools remain blocked. Updates the shop explanation and logs the automatic Drone request. Preserves puzzle solving, automatic Basement exit, TNT and whole-pile farm roaming.
